rawText: I keep getting headaches, my mom always talks for me, I forget things.
stomach hurts after lunch maybe since monday??
my knee. also i dont like loud rooms. can i have a quiet room
I need a refill, I forget the name, the white pill
tired all the time. sleep is bad. I get nervous when they take blood
i dont know what to say. everything.
Dr said come back in 2 weeks, why?

I have been feeling off for a long time and I do not know where to start. My head hurts in the afternoon and it gets worse when the room is loud. I forget what the doctor says as soon as I leave the room. My sister usually talks for me and I let her because it is easier. I want to ask about the pills I take at night but I forget the name of them. The waiting room makes me nervous and I start to shake a little. I do not like it when people touch my arm without telling me first. Last month the nurse spoke very fast and I just nodded. I did not understand the paper they gave me but I did not say anything. My stomach feels tight when I think about the appointment. I am not sure which things are important to tell the doctor and which are not. Sometimes I sleep badly and then the next day everything feels louder. I would like the doctor to write things down for me. I would also like to know what happens next after the visit. My hand shakes when I hold a cup. It started a while ago. It is worse when I am nervous. I drop things at work. My manager noticed it. I drink a lot of coffee. I sleep late most nights. My father had shaky hands too. I do not know if that matters. I want to know if I should be worried. I get embarrassed in meetings. I hide my hands under the table. I would like a test if one exists. I would also like to know who to see next. Please explain things slowly.
